comment: timeout.c restore_timers() through restore.c getlev(): each restored level timer goes through insert_timer(), so the queue stays in expiry order. A debug Valkyrie wishes for a glob, whose SHRINK_GLOB timer is global while she carries it, and for a newt corpse, which she drops so its ROT_CORPSE timer is local to Dlvl 1. She level-teleports to Dlvl 2 and back, then searches one turn at a time with the m prefix, which a nearby monster cannot refuse; the glob must shrink near turn 26 although the restored corpse timer expires much later. Seed and date were chosen independently of every recorded session.
